note: NAMED baseline of known-failing tests in the `jess` package suite, consumed by
It is a SET, never a count. A count cannot tell 'nothing changed' apart from
'you fixed one and broke another' — both read as the same number. Each entry names one test,
so the failure output and the git diff both say which test moved and which way.
Shrinking is easy: delete the entry. The gate REQUIRES you to, and names the
entry to delete, the moment a listed test starts passing. Growing is deliberate:
a new failure fails the gate and must be fixed, not appended here.
The 8 entries below are LONG-STANDING deterministic failures on dev (none are
timeouts), diagnosed and given a per-entry fix plan in
docs/state/jess-known-failures-fix-plan.md. They are recorded so the gate
reflects reality; the plan is how each one leaves this list.
`flaky: true` parks a genuinely unstable test: it never gates in either
direction, and it MUST carry a `tracking` pointer. It is an open bug, not an
excuse — do not use it to silence a deterministic failure.

knownFailures.test: test/diagnostics.test.ts > Diagnostic display tiers renderString reports a collected parser diagnostic without a plain duplicate error
knownFailures.reason: instanceof Error fails: JessError intentionally no longer extends Error (perf commit b16d69578); assertion contradicts deliberate design — retarget to JessError or escalate the public-throw contract.

knownFailures.test: test/dialect-builtins.test.ts > per-dialect built-ins registers only what a dialect index exports
knownFailures.reason: quote/unquote were converted to real defineFunction built-ins (fns/src/sass/string/{quote,unquote}.ts); the test's 'still-unconverted' exemplars are stale — pick genuinely-unconverted globals.

knownFailures.test: test/jess-render.test.ts > Jess parser plugin render-through parent selector accepts `&` as a $extend target while keeping $apply class-only by default
knownFailures.reason: Jess extend-policy validator (parse-with.ts isSimpleAllowed) has no branch for the parent-ref &; $extend & is rejected at parse instead of parsing + no-op-matching at eval.

knownFailures.test: test/jess-render.test.ts > Jess parser plugin render-through reports unresolved Jess interpolation through the public structured diagnostic route
knownFailures.reason: Jess ${…} interpolation is not parsed inside @import url(...); yields parse/syntax-error @1:14 instead of parsing + resolve/name-not-found @1:13.

knownFailures.test: test/path-resolution.test.ts > Less path resolution keeps a second document base through reference-url imports and inline multiple
knownFailures.reason: @import (reference) suppresses a nested @import (inline) payload (reference-visibility over-suppression); inline CSS must emit regardless of an ancestor reference flag. Shares one fix with the compat-hooks case.

knownFailures.test: test/path-resolution.test.ts > Less path resolution preserves that base when legacy compatibility hooks are also configured
knownFailures.reason: Same reference-visibility over-suppression as the reference-url case, plus lessCompatPlugin() (no behavioral change) — one fix covers both.

knownFailures.test: test/less/bootstrap-clean-repro.test.ts > bootstrap clean render renders and collects rejections
knownFailures.reason: bootstrap-less-port _navbar.less:250 uses a root-level leading-combinator '> .container' which jess v5 rejects by design (DESIGN-DECISIONS P29 / root-leading-combinator settled); the parser also mislocates the error to the following each() @256:50. Owner-gated dialect decision + a separable diagnostic-mislocation bug.

knownFailures.test: test/less/bootstrap-memory-bisect.test.ts > bootstrap execution-memory bisect renders the requested ordered import prefix
knownFailures.reason: Same root-level leading-combinator rejection as bootstrap-clean-repro (_navbar.less:250); bootstrap never emits CSS so the ordered-prefix render aborts. Owner-gated + shared diagnostic bug.

knownFlakyElsewhere.status: NOT allowlisted anywhere — that lane still gates on it at full strength.
knownFlakyElsewhere.reason: Intermittently fails only in full-suite runs. Under separate investigation as real cross-compile state contamination, NOT test flakiness. Recorded here so this ratchet work cannot be mistaken for having buried it.
